title: Clarinetist George Baquet's tone and a job with Punch Miller
summary: He describes a big-toned clarinetist and plays one advertising job with Punch.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Some of the other players around I guess you got to hear, I think you mentioned George Boyd, did you once? Yeah, George Boyd.
Because we never heard him, he died before he made any records and nobody, what kind of
Was he smooth or rough or did he, big tone or what was he?
He had a big tone. He was pretty strong, he had a big tone. He played, he was a kid punch clarinet.
Oh that's right, yeah. Did you ever play with punch too or any time?
Well I guess I only had the opportunity to play one job with him and that was an advertisement. On the truck. On the truck. Yes.
